pokemon_breeder_m.name: Man
dialog: The Gym here is a greenhouse inside, and every Pokémon in it is a Grass type.
Fire scorches them and Flying moves batter them. Bug, Ice and Poison do nicely too.

expert_m.name: Old Man
dialog: On the east side of town stands a statue of a Pokémon from Sinnoh's oldest tales.
It was already old when my grandfather's grandfather was a boy. Go and have a look at it.

ninja_boy.name: Boy
dialog: Shh! I'm hiding in the statue's shadow. Nobody has found me all day!

bug_catcher_1.name: Bug Catcher
dialog: The cycle shop's bicycles fold up small enough to go in your Bag. I want one so much!
On a bike you could race down the Cycling Road, south of town.

bug_catcher_2.name: Bug Catcher
dialog: West of here is Route 205, and past it Eterna Forest.
Bug Pokémon by the hundred live in those woods. I'm in there every weekend!

pokemon_breeder_f_1.name: Woman
dialog: The herb shop at the top of town sells medicine made from plants.
It's cheap and it works, but it's so bitter that a Pokémon sulks at you for days afterwards.

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: Have you met the Underground Man? He lives right beside the Pokémon Center.
They say he has dug tunnels under half of Sinnoh, and he'll tell you about every one.

pokemon_breeder_f_2.name: Woman
dialog: Through the gate to the south is the Cycling Road: Route 206.
You'll want a bicycle. Nobody gets down that road on foot.
